rubrics.justification: The response gives a plausible Day-5 expanded blastocyst assessment and reasonable ICM/TE grading, but it adds uncertain fine details such as a vacuole/excluded cell, minimal debris, and moderate symmetry that may not be reliably inferable from a single image.

It integrates age, BMI, ovarian response, sperm parameters, diagnosis, endometrium, and first-cycle status well, and appropriately frames young age as offsetting middling morphology; AMH absence is acknowledged.

The reasoning is structured and mostly internally consistent, with the prognosis logically tied to embryo morphology and favorable patient factors. Minor issues include somewhat over-quantified adjustments and speculative deductions from limited data.

Single embryo transfer and general prognosis counseling are guideline-concordant, but recommendations such as routine consideration of assisted hatching, ERA after a single failure, immunologic workup/NK cells, and adding estradiol are not strongly supported by major IVF guidelines.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET and standard luteal support, though some suggested future investigations/interventions are more aggressive than typically indicated after one failed transfer.
